title: Leaf rectangles of a protocol form a monochromatic partition
statement: Let $p$ be a deterministic two-party communication protocol over input types $X$ and $Y$ producing outputs in $\alpha$, and let $g : X \to Y \to \alpha$. If $p$ computes $g$, then the collection of leaf rectangles of $p$ is a monochromatic rectangle partition of $X \times Y$ for $g$: every leaf rectangle is a rectangle and is monochromatic for $g$, the leaf rectangles cover all of $X \times Y$, and any two distinct leaf rectangles are disjoint.
hypotheses_covered: p is a deterministic protocol over X, Y with outputs in α
p computes g (p.run x y = g x y for all x, y)
replaced:
If $p$ computes $g : X \to Y \to \alpha$, then the collection $\texttt{leafRectangles}(p)$
is a monochromatic rectangle partition of $X \times Y$ with respect to $g$: every element
is a rectangle, the elements are pairwise disjoint, their union is all of $X \times Y$,
and each element is $g$-monochromatic.
